Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto turns 36 today.
 
He ended the Eusobio clan’s 27-year rule in Pasig when he won in the May 2019 midterm elections, becoming the youngest chief executive of a local government in Metro Manila.
 
He will serve his third consecutive and last term this year following his landslide victory in the 2025 midterm elections.
